_read_me: Give every actor the least grants it needs. A grant is "action:resource", for example "write:plan:published". "read:*" reads everything. See _catalog. The tests in tests/architecture.test.mjs check the gates.

human:corinne.why: Planner. Publishes plans, validates rules, overrides, can stand in for Sylvie on events.

human:sylvie.why: Event desk. Proposes and confirms events (she checks the facts), proposes rules, uses what-if.

human:stephane.why: Key accounts. Asks what-if, gives promises from the plan and records when the customer got an answer; never confirms his own requests.

human:kevin.why: Night shift leader. Records deviations, proposes rules, uses what-if before a swap.

human:nadia.why: IT. Reads the audit trail; holds the kill switch and enables SAP write-back in this file.

agent:event-reader.why: Reads a message into a proposed event. Cannot confirm, cannot publish.

agent:explainer.why: Writes a short explanation of a plan. Reads plans, writes nothing.

service:long-solver.why: Daily run. Writes a draft, never a published plan.

service:fast-solver.why: Repair after a confirmed event. Writes a draft only.

service:sap-writeback.why: Writes the published plan into SAP process orders. Off until Nadia enables it.

human:herve.why: Site director, sponsor. Reads the published plan and the scorecard.

human:julien.why: Plant controller. Reads the scorecard and the audit trail to sign the baseline and the gain.

agent:ontology-assistant.why: Reads a mail or a remark and PROPOSES one change to the model (a field, a link, a rule). Cannot apply it: Corinne validates.
